super.structure: Anti-Public Anchor Super (key data-proven, fade trap chalk on top)
super.rationale: Keying on DATA, not chalk. #12 Chief Wallabee (Beyer 103, Prime Power 143, jockey Mike Smith — but no public-bias score: boring name, no story, low star recognition = under-bet). #18 Further Ado (HIGHEST Beyer 105 in field, Prime Power 150.7 = top-2). Wheel includes the trap chalk #1+#6 in ITM positions only — they can hit 3rd/4th, but public has them too short to KEY for top spots. + overlay #15 Emerging Market. SCRATCH: #9 The Puma scratched — wheel now 12,18,1,6,15,8.
super.mathNote: Hit prob = Σ over 120 permutations of (key wins) × (Henery σ for 2nd) × (Henery τ for 3rd) × (Henery ε for 4th), each renormalized to exclude prior finishers.

place.structure: Place bet on top public overlay
place.rationale: #15 Emerging Market (15.0/1) is a PUBLIC_OVERLAY — under-bet by casual money (low fluency name, no story, unfamiliar trainer/jockey). Place bet returns capital if hits 1st OR 2nd — Derby chaos covers a lot at this price.

steps.name: BRIS PP Parse
steps.detail: 50+ fields per horse: Beyer last 3, Prime Power, jockey/trainer pct, ML odds, post, running style, days since last, sire stats, mud%, weight, equipment.

steps.name: Benter Market Anchor
steps.detail: Convert ML odds → implied probability → renormalize to sum 1.0. Market is the baseline — algo only models the residual where market is wrong.

steps.name: CD Track Bias Multiplier
steps.detail: Per (surface × distance) apply post-position IV + running-style IV. e.g. dirt sprint post 1-3 = 1.55x, post 8+ = 0.62x. Style E = 1.45x, S = 0.35x.

steps.name: BRIS Ability Factor
steps.detail: z-score within field of (Prime Power × 0.6 + best last-3 Beyer × 0.4). Multiplier 1.0 + 0.25z, clamped 0.7–1.4. Mud-track adjust via sire-stats mud%.

steps.name: Jockey/Trainer Tier Bonus
steps.detail: Top CD operators get +0.03 to +0.07 additive (1 + j_bonus + t_bonus).

steps.name: Final Win Probability
steps.detail: win_prob = market × bias × tier × ability → renormalize across field.

steps.name: Henery Position Probabilities
steps.detail: P(2nd) via γ=0.81, P(3rd) via δ=0.65, P(4th) via ε=0.55 (Lo & Bacon-Shone 2008). Marginalize over winner & place finisher to get per-horse P(1)/P(2)/P(3)/P(4).

steps.name: Public Bias Overlay
steps.detail: Score each horse on color (gray=+2), name fluency, trainer/jockey/sire star, story narrative, post superstition, AI consensus. Flag PUBLIC_TRAP / OVERLAY / CONSENSUS_TRAP.

steps.name: Ticket Structure Selection
steps.detail: Edge tier × field size × angles × bias flags → recipe: forward exacta, key tri, super wheel, place bet, multi-race chain. KEY non-trap algo top + overlay; FADE trap chalk in keys (use as ITM coverage only).
